notes:
• Stellwerk for Mac: a Usage tab beside Setup and Run shows Claude's limits (session, week, week per model) for each Claude account. A second account can be added in Settings → Agents with a token from `claude setup-token`; "Use" switches to it. Optionally, a turn that would draw on extra usage stops and carries on with an account that has room, or just stops. Mac only: the phones don't show limits yet.
• Stellwerk for Mac: Install from source (Settings → Advanced). A row at the bottom of the sidebar builds Stellwerk from its project on this Mac, the default branch or a workspace, and installs it with a restart. Release updates keep coming: the next release replaces the build.
• Experimental token hints (Mac: Settings → Experimental, on every device): in a big Claude chat, the message box suggests /compact after a long pause, when the cached context has expired, and offers to send a message that starts a separate task in a new chat (Haiku on the Mac judges while you type). Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android.
• Android: leaving a screen always ends its live feed; before, it could stay open in the background when the screen closed right after connecting.
• Mac: the Team chats block under each project is gone; a people button next to the project's "+" opens Search on that project's teammates' sessions (People: Teammates). Search's filter shows "Team · Teammates" when People is set, and a project without rows yet shows its name instead of its id.
• Stellwerk for Mac: a downloaded update shows at the bottom of the sidebar ("Update available"), with "Install now" under the pointer. While agents are working it asks first, since the restart ends them.
• Team: a session continued in a new workspace brings its chat along; the new chat showed nothing before (the agent knew the history, you didn't). Prompts from Conductor with attached files no longer show its instructions at the start.
